results.algorithm: Linear classification with Sigmoid mapping & L2 Log-loss minimization
results.strengths: Fast convergence, highly transparent mathematical coefficients, linear auditability for fair lending compliance.
results.weaknesses: Fails to capture minority default class (recall: 3.3%) due to 88.4% class imbalance without reweighting or threshold adjustment.
results.verdict: Excellent statistical baseline; achieves 88.5% accuracy and 83.7% weighted F1 score.

results.algorithm: Recursive binary tree partitioning using Gini Impurity reduction
results.strengths: Naturally captures non-linear interactions between risk factors, easy if-then decision rule generation.
results.weaknesses: Prone to high variance and leaf overfitting, lower overall accuracy (80.1%) on unpruned splits.
results.verdict: Superb for explainable rule discovery and audit trails, but lower stability on noisy boundaries.

results.algorithm: Ensemble of 100 de-correlated trees with Bootstrap Aggregation & random feature subsampling
results.strengths: Substantially reduces variance, achieves best precision on default flag, robust against outliers.
results.weaknesses: Higher compute requirements across large cohorts; ensemble black-box nature requires SHAP values.
results.verdict: Recommended production champion for risk minimization and optimal portfolio stability.

results.algorithm: Instance-based classification using Minkowski/Euclidean distance in standardized space
results.strengths: Non-parametric, makes zero assumptions about underlying data distributions, cluster-intuitive.
results.weaknesses: High inference latency (computes distance to all training instances per query), sensitive to feature scale.
results.verdict: Good comparative baseline, but unsuitable for real-time high-throughput microservices due to query latency.
